interpretation: Architecture/scope comparison against a source-derived symbolic process approximation.
forecast_interpretation: Observed-weather hindcast; no measured discharge enters model inputs or states.

audit.budget_policy: Budget lists paired by position; shorter lists retain their last value. Target/mixed models pool all selected targets at each scenario's budgets.
audit.observation_policy: First N available training labels per target. Source models use source labels only; no held-out labels enter neural fitting or normalization.
audit.neural_validation_policy: Fixed training epochs; no validation/test labels select neural baseline checkpoints.
audit.units: Daily water quantities in mm; temperature in Celsius
audit.storage_equation: S_next = S + liquid - ET - Q; snow_next = snow + snowfall - melt
audit.runoff_equation: Q = overflow + retained * sigmoid(F(S/C, liquid/C, PET/C) + offset)
